create_azure_text_moderation_guardrail: create an AzureContentSafetyTextModerationGuardrail instance with api_key, api_base, and optional severity thresholds
test_check_severity_threshold: test checking if an Azure Text Moderation response crosses configured severity thresholds per category
run_async_pre_call_hook: run the pre-call hook to scan user prompts before sending them to an LLM
run_async_post_call_success_hook: run the post-call hook to scan successful LLM responses for policy violations
run_async_post_call_streaming_hook: run the streaming hook to scan incremental LLM streaming output for policy violations
